import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])

    seen = set()
    ans = 1

    for i in range(1, p):
        if i not in seen:
            cur = i
            cnt = 0
            while cur not in seen:
                seen.add(cur)
                cnt += 1
                cur = (cur * k) % p

            t = pow(k, cnt, p)
            if t != 1 and t != 0:
                ans = ans * (cnt + 1) % MOD
            else:
                ans = ans * p % MOD

    if k == 1:
        ans = ans * p % MOD

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
